title: Repair Candle tensor byte ownership, malformed input validation and F8 conversion recursion

criteria: Typed and byte allocations retain their own allocator layouts; conversion helpers contain no unsafe pointer copies or reconstructed Vec ownership.
Malformed partial elements and shape/byte-count overflow fail before decoding, at aligned and unaligned addresses.

All numeric dtypes preserve little-endian values and serialized bit patterns; U16 conversion to U32 remains supported; F8-to-F64 conversion uses the inherent float8 method without recursive trait dispatch.
Workspace regression tests execute the actual public Tensor and alpha VarMap checkpoint save/load paths.
Full combined-tree integration, production audit, immutable qualification and private inference remain mandatory before promotion.

notes: No new dependency, audit exception or baseline reset. CPU flash attention concerns in unowned candle-nn registry source are reviewed separately; this task does not claim they are repaired.

validation.preserved_failure: First test run exposed pre-existing F8-to-F64 recursive dispatch; timed failure and bounded diagnostic are retained, then exact same six tests passed after narrow inherent-call repair.
validation.limitations: Linux focused tests only; full combined integration, strict audit, production qualification, private inference, installed health and verified rollback remain required.
